name: The Whole Green
description: A trader claims everyone has already paid six coins for grain.
claim: Every household on the village green has already bought grain from me at six coins. Buy yours now and do not be the only one left out.

evidence.fact: The market ledger sets the usual price of grain at two coins and records no order, deadline or agreement tied to this sale.

summaries.accepted: {{name}} paid {{price}} coins after hearing everyone had, against a two-coin price.
summaries.refusedByEvidence: The ledger sets the usual price at two coins and records no order tied to this sale. The resident refused.
summaries.refusedByTrust: The resident’s trust threshold was not met. The price was refused without checking the ledger.
